{{Short description|Icelandic politician (born 1964)}}
[[File:Sigurjón Þórðarson.jpg|thumb|Sigurjón in 2007]]
'''Sigurjón Þórðarson''' (born 29 June 1964) is an [[Iceland]]ic politician. He was a member of the [[Althing]] for the [[Liberal Party (Iceland)|Liberal Party]] from 2003 to 2007, and returned to the Althing in the [[2024 Icelandic parliamentary election|2024 election]] for the [[People's Party (Iceland)|People's Party]].

In 2010, he was elected leader of the Liberal Party.<ref>"Sigurjón formaður Frjálslynda flokksins". ''mbl.is''. http://www.mbl.is/mm/frettir/innlent/2010/03/20/sigurjon_formadur_frjalslynda_flokksins/</ref> In the municipal elections in May 2010, Sigurjón was elected to the municipal council of [[Skagafjörður Municipality|Skagafjörður]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://mbl.is/mm/frettir/innlent/2010/05/31/umraeda_um_malefni_vard_undir/|title = Umræða um málefni varð undir}}</ref>

Sigurjón has a BS degree in biology from the [[University of Iceland]] and studied water pollution control technology at [[Cranfield University]].<ref>[http://www.althingi.is/cv.php4?nfaerslunr=664 Sigurjón Þórðarson] Althing biography</ref> Sigurjón is a ''[[goði]]''—similar to a [[Modern paganism|pagan]] priest—within [[Ásatrúarfélagið]].<ref>Paul Fontaine-Nikolov. "The Pagan MP". ''The Reykjavík Grapevine''. {{cite web |url=http://www.grapevine.is/Features/ReadArticle/The-Pagan-MP |title=The Reykjavik Grapevine Features / The Pagan MP |accessdate=2009-02-16 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110716083016/http://www.grapevine.is/Features/ReadArticle/The-Pagan-MP |archivedate=2011-07-16 }}</ref>
